description: Ministry of Tourism Development - Order declaring Tourist Enterprises & Tourist Services and Fees
categorisation: This gazette contains an order made under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005, which declares certain enterprises and services as "Tourist Enterprises" and "Tourist Services" respectively. It also establishes a regulatory framework and fee structure for licensing and registration. This content falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes, which include "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations," "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation," and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a minister is named, the primary purpose is regulatory, not about the individual's appointment or portfolio responsibilities.
